headers.Authorization: Bearer token supplied by the n8n credential 'GHL Private Integration Token' (Header Auth)

changesFromOriginal.messageBody: Renamed to 'message'. GHL ignores 'messageBody', so the logged message would be blank.
changesFromOriginal.status: Removed. Not accepted on this endpoint; GHL records the message as delivered once it's logged.
changesFromOriginal.conversationProviderId: Added. Required by GHL to record a message sent outside GHL (here, by Twilio).
changesFromOriginal.altId: Added. Stores the Twilio Message SID so the GHL record can be traced back to Twilio.
changesFromOriginal.endpoint: Use /conversations/messages/inbound with direction 'outbound'. POST /conversations/messages would make GHL SEND a second SMS.
changesFromOriginal.escaping: In n8n, use the JSON.stringify expression in ghl_log_outbound_body.n8n.txt instead of quoted {{ }} placeholders. Otherwise a reply containing a double quote or a newline produces invalid JSON and the request fails.
